title: Turn and Live
description: The people of Israel complain that sin burdens them and ask how they can live. God answers that He takes no pleasure in the death of the wicked, but rather that they turn from their ways. He explains the principle of individual responsibility: A righteous person who turns to evil will die, while a wicked person who repents, returns what was pledged, makes restitution for what was stolen, and does what is right shall live. In this way, God refutes the claim that His way is not just.
